patches: Two edits of source/xatlas/xatlas.cpp, each leaving the atlas the same bit for bit. 1. ClusteredCharts::mergeCharts (the xatlas fork's commit 216e3d0, +65/-25; in 0.0.11+spellcast3d.1): the boundary walk records the neighbours it touches and only those are visited and reset (not every chart id, with three per-chart arrays zeroed each time); a chart tested and merged with nothing is skipped until it or a neighbour changes (not re-tested after every merge); merged charts are compacted in one pass. The candidates, their order and every test are unchanged. 2. The chart growing and the task scheduler (the xatlas fork's commit e71b24a, +160/-36; new in 0.0.11+spellcast3d.2): a chart's boundary grid - the overlap test of every face a chart tries to take - cleared all its cells and walked each cell's list to its end for every edge it inserted, once per face tried; now only the cells the grid before used are cleared, each cell keeps its list's tail, the cells each edge traverses are kept for the grid's check against itself, and piecewise parameterization's checks of a few edges run from per-edge cell rectangles without the cell lists. The scheduler woke every worker for every task and the waiting thread spun; now one worker a task (a woken worker runs tasks from every group until none is left, and the waiting thread runs its group's queued tasks itself) and wait() sleeps until the group's last task ends. The lists, their order and every test are unchanged. The same edit is in Spellcast3D's cumesh wheel (code/release/wheels/cumesh/patch_cumesh_win.py, the hunks xatlas-grid-and-scheduler-*).
